verses.1: Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.
verses.2: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.3: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.
verses.4: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. [Selah
verses.5: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.6: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life; His years shall be as many generations.
verses.7: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.8: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
